card.name: Stepwise dose series and tables
card.fires_on: Words and number pieces inside stepwise procedures or graded series, such as methacholine challenge dosing steps and tables of descending values. Often a small word like "the" or "each" right before the next item in the sequence.

modes.label: Challenge test steps
modes.description: Small words or dose terms in step-by-step instructions for a methacholine or nebulizer test.
modes.example: Record the post-diluent FEV1 value and calculate the ≥ 20% FEV1 reduction value before starting<< the>> methacholine challenge test.

modes.label: Number tables
modes.description: Pieces of numbers in rows of graded values, such as decimals or weight-band dose charts.

modes.label: Inside product names
modes.description: Partway through names like Provocholine or Syrup in this same setting.
